document.abstract: Many Excellent instruments have been designed to keep cameras and recorders in sync and to provide bleep or start marks for the editor; however, for a small film unit, such equipment can be unduly expensive. The inexpensive (less than $150) equipment described in this paper was designed for a tenminute documentary film of the General Conference of the United Methodist Church held last year in the Municipal Auditorium in Dallas. The Conference was attended by some 1,200 delegates
